rotate.pattern: Subscribe for the college football, hockey or other season you follow, then cancel. Compare the Disney+, Hulu and ESPN Select bundle ($21.99 with ads) if you want all three.

cancel.howTo: Manage it where you bought it: your Disney or ESPN account on the web, or Apple, Google, Amazon or Roku if you subscribed there. Choose Cancel subscription.
cancel.gotchas: Plans bought inside a Disney bundle are cancelled in the Disney account. The September 2026 price rise took effect on September 17. Annual plans are billed up front.

name: Everand (Scribd)
why: Everand gives a set number of premium titles a month ($11.99 for one, $16.99 for three), and its listing says unlocks roll over for up to 6 months. Heavy-reading stretches suit it better than year-round billing.

alternatives.name: Libby (public library)
alternatives.note: Free ebooks and audiobooks with a library card.

alternatives.name: Hoopla
alternatives.note: Free with a library card: audiobooks, comics, music and some video, with a monthly borrow limit.

rotate.pattern: Subscribe when you have a stack of books to read, use the monthly unlocks, then cancel. Library apps cover the gaps.

cancel.howTo: Sign in at everand.com, open Account settings, go to Membership and choose Cancel membership. If you subscribed in an app store, cancel there.
cancel.gotchas: The website offers a 30-day free trial that converts to paid unless you cancel before it ends; app-store trials may differ. Subscriptions auto-renew until cancelled. Plans are sold by unlocks, so check which tier you are on.

name: Fubo
why: Fubo is the sports-first live TV option, and reported plan prices run well above Sling. Plan prices conflicted across sources, so check your own bill and join per season.

alternatives.name: Sling Orange or Blue

alternatives.name: YouTube TV Sports plan
alternatives.note: $64.99 for a sports-focused channel set.

cancel.howTo: Sign in at fubo.tv, open Account, go to Manage Subscription and choose Cancel, then follow the prompts.
cancel.gotchas: Add-ons such as My Local Sports renew separately. Disney and Fubo closed their Hulu + Live TV deal in October 2025 but the services were still sold separately, so check which one bills you. If billed through Apple, Roku or Amazon, cancel there.

name: HBO Max (formerly Max)
why: HBO Max raised prices again in late 2025 and its draw is a few tentpole series. Join for a season, binge, leave. Annual plans save about 16% but only pay off if you would stay all year.

alternatives.name: Disney+, Hulu and HBO Max bundle

cancel.howTo: Sign in at hbomax.com, open your profile, go to Subscription (or Settings), choose Cancel Subscription and confirm.
cancel.gotchas: If HBO Max is billed through Amazon, Apple, Roku, a Disney+ or Hulu bundle, or a TV provider, you must cancel there. Access continues to the end of the paid period. Annual plans are paid up front.

name: Kindle Unlimited
why: Kindle Unlimited is a binge product at $143.88 a year, and borrowed books disappear when you stop. Read a stack over two or three months, cancel, and use library apps in between.

alternatives.name: Libby (public library)

name: MLB.TV
why: MLB.TV is a seasonal product. The pass fell to $139.99 in May 2026, and a monthly plan has been sold near $30, so month by month wins if you watch four months or fewer. Do not let a season pass renew by default.

alternatives.name: MLB.TV on ESPN
alternatives.note: Cord Cutters News reported a $124.99 season price for ESPN Unlimited subscribers in May 2026.

name: NBA League Pass

why: League Pass runs October to April. NBA.com lists $109.99 for the season and $159.99 for Premium. Blackouts make the value depend on your team, so take the season pass only if you will watch most of it.

rotate.pattern: Buy the season pass if you watch most of the year, or go month to month for the stretch you care about, such as the playoffs, then cancel. Turn off renewal before the next season.

cancel.howTo: If you bought on NBA.com, cancel in your NBA.com profile. If you bought in the NBA app, cancel in the app store you used. Cancel before the next billing event.

name: Netflix
why: The one catalog most households use all year, so rotating saves less than elsewhere. If ads are tolerable, Standard with ads at $8.99 is the cheaper move than Standard at $19.99.

alternatives.name: Netflix Standard with ads

cancel.gotchas: Signing out or deleting the app does not cancel. You keep access until the paid period ends. If you are billed through a carrier, internet provider or app store, the Cancel button may be missing and you must cancel with that partner. Price increases land on your next bill.

name: Nintendo Switch Online
why: At $19.99 a year this is the cheapest subscription here. Keep it if you play online or use cloud saves. The $49.99 Expansion Pack only matters if you want the classic game libraries.

alternatives.name: Family membership
alternatives.note: $34.99 a year covers up to 8 accounts.

cancel.gotchas: Per Nintendo, turn off auto-renewal at least 48 hours before the membership expires; access continues to the end of the term with no refund, and cloud save backups become unavailable afterward. A free trial converts to a 1-month auto-renewing membership at the then-current price unless you turn off renewal.

name: Pandora (Plus and Premium)

cancel.gotchas: Prices differ by platform: app-store billing has been reported higher than direct. Free ad-supported listening continues after you cancel.

name: Paramount+

alternatives.name: Pluto TV

name: Peacock

cancel.gotchas: If you pay through Apple, Roku, Amazon or a cable provider, cancel there. Existing subscribers move to the August 2026 prices on their first bill on or after September 17. Annual plans are paid up front.

name: Philo

cancel.gotchas: Bundle+ at $33 adds HBO Max Basic with Ads, AMC+ and discovery+, which you may already pay for separately. Add-on channel packs renew with the plan.

name: PlayStation Plus
why: Online play on PlayStation needs Essential, so keep it and buy the 12-month plan ($79.99) over monthly ($10.99). Extra and Premium are catalogs; add them for a few months when games you want appear.

name: Prime Video Channels and add-ons

haggle.leverage: Say you are about to cancel and that free radio, Pandora and Spotify cover most of your listening. Retention agents have room to offer promotional pricing, but only if you ask.
haggle.script: Hi, I'm calling about my SiriusXM subscription, which renews soon at $[current price] a month. That is more than I want to pay, and Pandora and Spotify cover most of what I listen to for much less. I've enjoyed SiriusXM and would like to stay if you can offer a better rate. Are there any promotions or lower-priced plans I qualify for? If not, please cancel the account at the end of this billing period and give me a confirmation number.
haggle.bestTime: Call 2 to 4 weeks before renewal and ask for cancellations or retention. SiriusXM asks for at least 24 hours before renewal, so do not wait for the last day.

cancel.howTo: Call 1-866-635-2349 or use the online cancellation request from the Help Center page for managing or cancelling a subscription. Cancel at least 24 hours before renewal; it ends with the current billing period.
cancel.gotchas: Intro offers ($1 for 3 months on the site) renew at the regular rate. Agents will present save offers; say plainly that you want to cancel and ask for a confirmation number. A trial that came with a new car converts to a paid plan unless you stop it.

name: The Criterion Channel

alternatives.name: Kanopy

name: TIDAL

selfhost.prompt: I am running you on the target machine (or over SSH to it); confirm that before changing anything. Help me move off Copilot Money to a self-hosted Actual Budget server. Target: an old laptop or Raspberry Pi running Linux with Docker, plus Tailscale so my iPhone can reach it. Please set up actualbudget/actual-server with a persistent data volume, restart policy and a strong password, then publish it to my tailnet over HTTPS with tailscale serve and walk me through adding the site to my iPhone home screen as a web app. Next, guide me through exporting my transactions from Copilot as CSV and importing them into Actual: map date, name, amount and category, create matching categories, and write rules so recurring merchants are categorized automatically. Set up nightly backups of the data folder to an external disk. Finally, list plainly what I give up compared with Copilot, such as automatic bank connections, investment tracking and its iOS design, and suggest a manual weekly routine to keep transactions up to date by CSV.

selfhost.prompt: I am running you on the target machine (or over SSH to it); confirm that before changing anything. Set up a self-hosted replacement for Monarch Money using Actual Budget. Target: an old laptop running Ubuntu Server 24.04, or a Raspberry Pi 5, with Docker and Tailscale. Steps: install Docker, run actualbudget/actual-server with a persistent /data volume and automatic restarts, expose it on my tailnet over HTTPS with tailscale serve, and set a server password. Then help me connect bank sync with SimpleFIN Bridge for my US accounts: explain how to create the SimpleFIN account, generate the setup token and add it in Actual, and warn me that sync keys are stored on the server unencrypted, so I should lock down disk access and backups. Show me how to import my Monarch transactions CSV export, build category rules from my existing categories, and recreate my top three reports. Add nightly backups of /data to an external drive with 30-day retention and test a restore. Finish with a checklist of what Monarch did that Actual will not, such as investment tracking.

cancel.howTo: Monarch says you can cancel anytime. Sign in on the web and open your subscription or billing settings to cancel; if you subscribed through the Apple App Store or Google Play, cancel in that store instead. Download your transactions as CSV before you leave.
cancel.gotchas: Promo codes apply only to annual Core plans billed directly by Monarch, not through Apple or Google. The pricing page advertises a no-questions-asked money-back guarantee, so ask about the window before you pay for an annual plan.

If that is not possible, please tell me how to disconnect and return equipment.
haggle.bestTime: Within 30 days before a promotion ends, or after a bill increase. Expect to call.

cancel.howTo: Optimum's moving page lists 877-694-9474 for cancelling by phone; promotion terms list other numbers, so use that one. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period, except in CT and NJ. Return equipment, with cables, power cords and remotes, at an Optimum store with photo ID and your account number, or by mail using Optimum's mail-in instructions.

name: YNAB (You Need A Budget)
why: YNAB's method is envelope budgeting, and Actual Budget is a mature open-source tool built on the same idea. It imports YNAB exports, so the switch is a weekend project. Bank sync is the main thing you give up.

alternatives.name: Actual Budget
alternatives.note: Free, open-source envelope budgeting you can run locally or self-host.

alternatives.name: Goodbudget
alternatives.note: Envelope budgeting app with a free tier that works from manual entry.

selfhost.youLose: Automatic bank connections: in the US, Actual syncs through SimpleFIN Bridge, a separate paid service you sign up for, or you import CSV files by hand. There is no native phone app, only a web app. YNAB's support and teaching content are gone. You handle updates and backups, and credit card payment categories do not map one for one on import. The cost figure adds about $15 a year for SimpleFIN Bridge.
selfhost.prompt: I am running you on the target machine (or over SSH to it); confirm that before changing anything. I want to replace my YNAB subscription with a self-hosted Actual Budget server. Target device: a Raspberry Pi 4 or 5, or an old laptop, running 64-bit Linux with Docker and Tailscale. Install Docker and Compose, then create a docker-compose.yml that runs actualbudget/actual-server with the latest-alpine tag, port 5006 and a persistent /data volume, restarting automatically. Install Tailscale and use tailscale serve so I can open Actual over HTTPS from my phone and laptop without exposing a port. Set a strong server password on first run. Add a nightly cron job that copies /data to a USB drive and keeps 14 days, a monthly restic copy to a second location, and an update script that can roll back. Finally, walk me through exporting my YNAB plan as JSON with a personal access token and importing it through Switch file, Import file, nYNAB, fixing a not-ynab5 error if it appears, then list the categories to clean up afterwards.

rebuild.whatYouBuild: An offline envelope-budgeting PWA with accounts (including credit cards), transfers and split transactions, monthly category groups, rollover, CSV import from your bank, scheduled transactions and a spending report.
rebuild.runsOn: Installable PWA on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages free tier, with data in IndexedDB on your device.
rebuild.youLose: Automatic bank sync (CSV import only), sync between devices except by exporting a JSON backup, YNAB's support and teaching, and polish. Budget math has to be tested carefully because mistakes are yours to find. Credit card handling is the hardest part and the place a budget goes quietly wrong.
rebuild.prompt: Build me a free, offline envelope budgeting app to replace YNAB, as an installable PWA with Vite, React and TypeScript and all data in IndexedDB. Core features: 1) accounts with a running balance, including credit card accounts, where spending moves money from the category to a payment category; 2) category groups with Assigned, Activity and Available per month, rollover and overspending flags; 3) quick entry, transfers between accounts, split transactions, and CSV import from my bank with column mapping and duplicate detection; 4) scheduled transactions; 5) a Ready to Assign banner and a spending-by-category report; 6) JSON export and import. Include an importer for YNAB's Register.csv and budget CSV that handles its "Transfer : Account" payees and splits. Write Vitest tests for the budget math, especially rollover, overspending, credit card payments, transfers and splits. Deploy free to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, explain installing it on my phone, and write a README.

cancel.howTo: Sign in at app.ynab.com/settings, scroll to Cancel your subscription and confirm. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your billing period. On a phone, billing settings are only in the web browser. If you subscribed through the App Store or Google Play, cancel in that store instead.
cancel.gotchas: The annual plan renews automatically for a year at a time, so cancel before the renewal date. YNAB gives no retroactive refunds. Export your plan data first if you want to import it into another tool.
